summary: Regression sprint after Menu Engineering router extraction. 15/16 tests pass (94%). Extracted /api/menu-engineering/analyze & /what-if work correctly. Recipes, plated-menus, inventory, production, buffet-factors, culinary-digest all intact. Recipes<->Proposals cost bridge verified (cost-staleness + refresh-costs endpoints both return 200). Only failure: /api/debug/whoami returns 404 — PRE-EXISTING ordering bug (endpoint defined AFTER app.include_router call), NOT introduced by this refactor (confirmed via git).

minor.issue: Returns 404 'Not Found'. Endpoint is defined at server.py line 24174 with @api_router.get(...), but app.include_router(api_router) executes at line 24162 — BEFORE the whoami route is registered on api_router. FastAPI's include_router copies routes at call-time, so any @api_router.get(...) added after line 24162 is never mounted on the app. Confirmed pre-existing (same ordering in git commit 287c024f). This orphans not just whoami but also potentially any other decorator added after line 24162.

action_items: Move /api/debug/whoami endpoint definition to BEFORE line 24162 (app.include_router(api_router)), OR move app.include_router(api_router) to end of file. Any @api_router.* declared after line 24162 will silently 404.

OPTIONAL: Seed a proposal item linked to a recipe (with recipe_id) so future regressions can verify unit_cost snapshot on proposal items directly. Currently the only proposal items available carry unit_price/line_total but no recipe_id linkage in seed data. The cost bridge itself (refresh-costs/cost-staleness) works correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >24k lines — the refactor sprint moving routers out (menu_engineering, culinary_digest, brand_hub, settings, partners, notifications) is correct direction; continue extracting proposals_router (~3000 lines) and plated_menus_router next.
Ordering hazard: app.include_router(api_router) at line 24162 followed by @api_router.get(...) at line 24174 creates silent 404s. Add a comment/lint or move the include to end of file.

rca_of_the_issue: RCA for /api/debug/whoami 404: FastAPI's app.include_router(router) copies router.routes into app.routes at call-time (not by reference). server.py line 24162 finalizes api_router → app. Line 24174 adds a new @api_router.get('/debug/whoami') decorator that appends to api_router.routes only — app.routes already snapshot at 24162 does not see it. Fix: relocate the whoami block above line 24162, or move the app.include_router call to end of file. Reproduction: GET {BASE_URL}/api/debug/whoami with valid Bearer → 404 {"detail":"Not Found"}. Not a regression from menu_engineering extraction (git show 287c024f confirms identical ordering pre-refactor).
